name: watermark
summary: Add a small semi-transparent text watermark in the bottom-right corner.
when: Proofs and previews sent to clients before final delivery.
photoshop: Type tool, set layer opacity to about 50 %; for many files record an Action and run File > Automate > Batch
notes: For batches use photocraft-cli batch with this recipe's steps; refs need run_recipe.py, so loop over files with it instead.
